items: 1/8 cup water + 1 tsp cornflour - for a light coating OR

method: Combine chicken with all the marinade ingredients and set aside ( i like to do this in the morning so flavours absorb slightly but you can do it just before cooking too )
Preheat airfryer to 180 degrees C while thats happening , add rice flour to the chicken and coat well ( this is what makes it crispy so dont skimp :) )
Add to the airfryer and cook till done

caption:
Airfryer Chilli Chicken 
airfryer recipe | high protein | meal prep friendly | 30 minute recipe 

SAVE THIS FOR YOUR NEXT DINNER!!!

Nutrition: 
C: 32 | F: 10 | P: 33
Calories: 341 per serving 
Serves 3

Ingredients
chicken marinade: 
450 grams chicken breast or thigh, cubed | use paneer for vegetarian option 
1 tbsp minced ginger garlic paste
4-5 garlic cloves, minced
1 tsp salt
1 tbsp chilli vinegar
1 tbsp soy sauce
3 tbsp rice flour 
1 tsp oil, for the airfryer 
 
for the stir fry, 
1 tsp oil
1 tbsp minced ginger and garlic 
2 green chillies, split 
1 onion, cut into cubes
1 bell pepper, cubed ( i used a mix of green, yellow and red )
sauce: 
2 tbsp dark soy sauce
1 tbsp vinegar
2 tbsp green chilli sauce
1 tsp black pepper or white pepper
slurry: 
1/8 cup water + 1 tsp cornflour - for a light coating OR 
1/2 cup water + 2 tsp cornflour - for a gravy
salt, to taste

coriander + sesame seeds for garnish

Method
combine chicken with all the marinade ingredients and set aside ( i like to do this in the morning so flavours absorb slightly but you can do it just before cooking too ) 
preheat airfryer to 180 degrees C while thats happening , add rice flour to the chicken and coat well ( this is what makes it crispy so dont skimp :) ) 
add to the airfryer and cook till done 
while thats happening, in a pan take oil + garlic + onion + chilli + capsicums and stir fry 
in a bowl combine all ingredients under “sauce” and add to the pan, let it cook for a minute then add in the slurry ( mentioned both quantities if you want it dry or wet gravy!! 
add in airfried chicken to the mix and coat evenly
garnish and dig in hot and fresh :)
